title: Update Goal (update_goal)
category: 目标管理 / 长期任务
summary: 更新当前目标的精确 revision：action 为 edit / pause / resume / complete / blocked。edit/pause/resume 需直接人工请求；自动继续期间允许 complete/blocked。blocked 需连续至少 3 轮同一阻塞条件并附 blocked_reason。
when_to_use: 目标需修改/暂停/恢复 → edit/pause/resume（需人工请求）
同一阻塞持续多轮 → blocked
not_for: 无人工请求时擅自 pause/resume

revision.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

max_goal_rounds.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

blocked_reason.description: Concrete blocking condition; required only with action blocked.

commands.name: update_goal
commands.usage: update_goal({ goal_id: "<id>", revision: 2, action: "edit|pause|resume|complete|blocked", objective?: "...", max_goal_rounds?: 10, blocked_reason?: "..." })
commands.desc: 必需 goal_id、revision、action；edit 可带 objective/max_goal_rounds；blocked 必带 blocked_reason
